About Us

Building Excellence, One Project at a Time

Jeshfield Global

A Beacon of Excellence in Nigeria

Jeshfield Global stands as a beacon of excellence in Nigeria's evolving industrial landscape. We represent the perfect fusion of time-honored tradition and cutting-edge innovation, delivering premium solutions across epoxy flooring, sustainable agriculture, and precision logistics.

Founded on principles of integrity and quality, we have grown to become a trusted partner for businesses and individuals seeking excellence. Our commitment to sustainability and community development drives every decision we make.

Our Mission

To deliver exceptional quality and innovative solutions that transform spaces, nourish communities, and connect businesses across Nigeria.

Our Vision

To be Africa's most trusted enterprise, recognized for excellence, innovation, and sustainable impact across multiple industries.

Our Core Values

Excellence

We maintain the highest standards in every project we undertake.

Integrity

Trust and transparency form the foundation of our business.

Innovation

We embrace modern techniques while honoring traditional values.

Partnership

We build lasting relationships with clients and communities.

What We Do

Our Services

Excellence across three core industries. Each service delivered with precision, passion, and an unwavering commitment to quality.

Luxury Interior Solutions

Epoxy Flooring

Transform your spaces with our premium epoxy flooring solutions. We specialize in creating stunning, durable surfaces that combine modern aesthetics with exceptional functionality for residential and commercial properties.

  • Metallic Epoxy Finishes
  • 3D Floor Designs
  • Industrial Coatings
  • Decorative Flakes
Premium Farm Products

Agriculture

Sustainable farming meets excellence. We cultivate and distribute high-quality agricultural products including snails, catfish, poultry, cassava, vegetables, periwinkle, and crayfish with dedication to quality and sustainability.

  • Live Snails & Catfish
  • Fresh Vegetables
  • Poultry Products
  • Seafood & Crayfish
Precision Delivery Services

Logistics

Reliable, efficient, and professional logistics solutions that connect businesses across Nigeria. From last-mile delivery to bulk transportation, we ensure your goods reach their destination safely and on time.

  • Express Delivery
  • Bulk Transportation
  • Warehousing
  • Nationwide Coverage
